gaps.fact: Flor is a film of Saccharomyces cerevisiae yeast strains. The Codex teaches what flor does and the strength that keeps it alive, never the species.

Sherry's other soils beside albariza: barros (clay) and arenas (sand). The jerez article (terroir) names them, and the explanations of one Village Terroir stem (c-jj8hsh1r, on albariza) and one region drill stem (r-oy90w2xn) mention them as the soils of lesser rank; no stem keys them and no chapter fact lists them.
Funchal is the main city of Madeira. Named in the madeira article only.

The Court's three labels: Madeira hot subtropical, Sherry hot maritime, Port warm to hot Mediterranean (with the physical features: mountainous hillside for Madeira and Port, the Atlantic close for Sherry).

Marsala's sweetness terms Secco, Semi-Secco and Dolce, beside its colours and ages. One Régionale explanation (i-9e023msc) and the sicily article (law, exam) carry them; no stem keys them and the Village Fortified Wines chapter's Marsala fact gives the ages (Fine, Superiore, Vergine) without the sweetness terms.

South Africa's fortified Muscats of the Klein Karoo (Western Cape), from Muscat de Frontignan (Muscat à Petits Grains). The south-africa country article mentions them; no stem or chapter fact in the fortified cats does.

How sweetness, age and oxidation steer a fortified pairing: dry flor Sherry with salt and oil, oxidative Tawny and Madeira with nuts and caramel, sweet Port with blue cheese and chocolate. The digestifs table pairs each drink; no stem asks the principle.

courtUpdates.printed: Same geographical area as Douro DOP, Portugal.
courtUpdates.now: Decree-Law 106/2025 approved a new Statute of the Douro Demarcated Region's designations: the 75,000 litre minimum stock to begin selling Porto DOP is removed, bottling at origin is required for the region's DOP and IGP wines and spirits, regional place names are reserved to DOP and IGP wines, Douro spirit becomes an IGP and a Porto wine vinegar category is created; the IVDP's implementing regulations follow.
courtUpdates.source: Portuguese Government communiqué on the new Statute; Decree-Law 106/2025 (FAOLEX); IVDP Regulation 954/2025 on the 2025 vintage declaration

courtUpdates.printed: Flor: Saccharomyces cerevisiae. Biological aging vs. oxidative aging. Running the scales of the Solera.
courtUpdates.now: Since the 2021 and 2022 revisions a Fino or Manzanilla that reaches 15 per cent unaided need not be fortified and ageing may finish anywhere in the DO zone (Manzanilla still in Sanlúcar), which the Codex already teaches; in 2023, before the guide's date, Beba, Perruno and Vigiriega joined the permitted grapes; the Consejo's plenary of 29 July 2025 opened a further modification to allow Fino, Manzanilla and Pale Cream at a minimum of 14 per cent, pending publication and not in force.
courtUpdates.source: Consejo Regulador de Jerez, recent regulatory changes page and Memoria 2023, 2024 and 2025; Junta de Andalucía modification request, November 2024

notes: Mapped questions: Régionale 61 (Sparkling/Fortified/Sweet, of which 28 are fortified stems: Port 9, Sherry 9, Madeira 4, Marsala 2, vins doux naturels 4), Village 35 (Fortified Wines), 96 in all and 63 on fortified wine itself; Portugal, Spain and Italy Central & South carry the appellation detail besides. Five Court rows print both cells blank on these pages (Grape Growing; Wine Law; Classification; Producer; History & Lore) and are not rows here. The Village Fortified Wines cat is deep on Port law and Madeira but asks nothing on Sherry's soils, flor's species or Marsala's sweetness terms; the Court's Certified line that sweeter Madeira styles are fortified earlier is asked by one Régionale Portugal stem (i-86b8pafs) and by nothing at Village. Court cells to read with care in our own copy: 'By-the-glass pours are typically 2 oz (51.9 ml)' on page 82 where 2 oz is 59.1 ml (the sweet wines page has it right); 'Klein Karoo: Muscat de Frontignan and Muscat à Petits Grains' names one grape twice; the Court files Amontillado and Palo Cortado under biological ageing where the Codex teaches Amontillado as both and Palo Cortado as the in between, so an e- question on the Court's row should key the Court's list. Two searches spent, on Port and on Sherry.
